lines.x: The Bank of Jamaica's Monetary Policy Committee unanimously decided to increase the policy rate by 50 basis points to 6.50% to address inflationary pressures.
The Bank of Jamaica has initiated a standard sale operation for US dollars to be conducted via the JamClear-CSD system.
Jamaica's fiscal revenue and grants fell J$27.8 billion ($175 million) short of budget estimates between April and September 2026 due to lower tax collections.
Jamaican financial firm Barita Investments launched a dual-currency debt issuance seeking to raise up to $30 million and J$4.5 billion to fund regional business expansion initiatives.
